Job Purpose: Responsible for executing field service interventions on power and distribution transformers, including installation supervision, commissioning, preventive maintenance and corrective repair. The role delivers assigned service scopes to specification, on schedule and in full compliance with safety requirements. Key Responsibilities: Installation & Commissioning Supervise transformer offloading, positioning, assembly of radiators, bushings and conservator, and oil filling. Execute drying-out, vacuum treatment and oil filtration where required prior to energisation. Perform pre-commissioning tests including ratio, winding resistance, insulation resistance, polarity and vector group verification. Preventive & Corrective Maintenance Carry out scheduled maintenance covering oil sampling, gasket inspection, bushing cleaning, silica gel and cooling system checks. Execute corrective interventions such as leak repair, gasket and gauge replacement and tap changer servicing. Verify operation of protection devices including Buchholz relay, oil and winding temperature indicators and pressure relief. Diagnostics & Condition Assessment Collect oil samples and interpret dissolved gas analysis and oil quality results. Perform and evaluate insulation diagnostics and identify developing faults. Recommend condition-based interventions and end-of-life assessments. Documentation & Reporting Prepare service reports, test records and customer sign-off documentation for every intervention. Maintain the maintenance history file for each serviced transformer. Report findings, spare requirements and recurring defects to the Service Manager. QHSE on Site Apply approved method statements, risk assessments and permit-to-work for all site activities. Enforce electrical isolation, earthing and confined-space and hot-work controls as applicable. Manage oil handling, containment and disposal in line with environmental requirements. Job Qualifications: Education: Bachelor's degree of Electrical Engineering or related field. Years of Experience: 0–2 years of experience Language proficiency: Good command of English Preferred experience in transformer installation, commissioning, testing or field maintenance.

Required Qualifications • 5 - 8 years of experience in RPG programming (RPG IV, RPGLE, Free-format RPG). • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). • Strong hands-on experience with DB2/400 and SQL for iSeries. • Solid experience in application development and maintenance on IBM iSeries (AS/400) platform. • Proficient in RPG/400, RPGLE, and Free-format RPG programming. • Strong knowledge of DB2 for i, SQL, and database design. • Experience in CL (Control Language) programming. • Familiarity with IBM iSeries system administration and performance optimization. • Experience with API and web service integration on IBM i is a plus. • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Key Responsibilities: • Develop and maintain applications using RPG (RPGLE, RPG/400, Free-format RPG) on IBM i (AS/400) platform. • Design and develop database solutions using DB2 for iSeries, including writing efficient SQL queries and embedded SQL. • Collaborate with business analysts and end-users to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. • Ensure adherence to coding standards, best practices, and security guidelines. • Provide ongoing maintenance and support for existing RPG and DB2 applications. • Troubleshoot issues, debug programs, and fix bugs. • Participate in system testing, QA, and debugging efforts. • Design, develop, and maintain DB2 databases including tables, views, indexes, and stored procedures. • Create and maintain technical documentation for applications, processes, and databases. • Ensure detailed and accurate documentation for any code changes or system upgrades. Soft Skills: • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. • Strong time-management and organizational skills. • A proactive attitude and the ability to work independently.

review_candidates.title: 3D Modeler
review_candidates.description: About the Role ASFAN International is looking for a skilled and creative 3D Modeler to join our team in Amman. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating high-quality 3D models and environments based on references, technical requirements, and project specifications. We are looking for someone with strong Blender skills, attention to detail, and the ability to produce realistic and optimized 3D assets. Responsibilities Create high-quality 3D models, objects, equipment, and environments. Develop models based on images, drawings, references, and project requirements. Create realistic materials and textures. Optimize 3D models while maintaining visual quality. Work closely with the development and design teams to meet project requirements. Requirements Strong experience with Blender. Good knowledge of 3D modeling, materials, texturing, and lighting. Ability to create realistic models from references. Previous professional or freelance experience in 3D modeling is preferred. Preferred Qualifications Experience creating architectural, industrial, educational, or technical 3D models is an advantage. Application Candidates must submit a portfolio or examples of previous 3D modeling work along with their application.
